summary: HQ / ownership: Australia; family-owned, CEO Leo Coates since 2008; offices supporting 50+ markets; ~500 staff (2022)
Digital menu boards (indoor + drive-thru), kiosks, and Switchboard CMS for global QSR

McDonald's global digital-menu-board CMS provider (5-year deal announced Aug 2022) and one of two approved hardware providers (with Acrelec) — "one global provider that could deliver our digital CMS vision" (Hashim Amin, McDonald's VP global product & engineering)
Heavy concentration in McDonald's; 5-year CMS term from 2022 implies renewal window ~2027
McDonald's piloting third-party ads on digital menu boards (Sep 22, 2026) — vendor not named

Coates still presents Switchboard CMS and indoor/outdoor QSR menu-board hardware; the McDonald’s global CMS selection in the pack dates to August 2022. (Scope note: Current site confirms product positioning, not the 2026 status or renewal date of the McDonald’s agreement.)

Coates reported receiving McDonald’s China’s 2025 Best Supplier Award at a 2026 supplier meeting. (Scope note: Supplier recognition confirms relationship but not present contract term or installed CMS footprint.)
